label.purpose: Buttons, nav items, chips, meta text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f766e; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #115e59; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; border-color: #cbd5e1; }

components.name: Collection Card
components.html: Girl in white Tshirt
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -4px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.12); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 12px; }

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #0f172a; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #f0fdfa; color: #0f766e; }

components.name: Input Field
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #0f172a; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0f766e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(15,118,110,0.15); }

narrative.overview: VisionCraft AI is a room where the photographs do the talking. Like a contact sheet or a light table, the interface is a quiet, neutral surface built to let images sit at full color and full attention — everything around them recedes into grayscale structure so nothing competes with the photo being edited. One accent color, a deep teal, marks what's actionable and what's active; it never spreads across gradients, banners, or backgrounds. This system explicitly rejects the generic purple/indigo SaaS gradient look this product shipped with previously.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with tonal layering instead of drop shadows
One geometric-technical typeface (IBM Plex Sans) carrying the whole hierarchy through weight
Structure and whitespace establish importance; no gradients or particle effects

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Deep Teal appears on primary buttons, active/selected states, links, and focus rings — and nowhere else.

rules.name: The No-Tint-Everything Rule
rules.body: Card borders and shadows stay neutral gray, never accent-tinted.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Width Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built by moving between 400/500/600 weight and size, never by introducing a second typeface or letter-spaced uppercase eyebrows.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No shadow is applied to a card, sidebar, or button in its default state. Depth is earned only by genuinely floating above other content.

dos: Do use Deep Teal (#0f766e) only for primary buttons, active nav state, links, and focus rings.
Do keep every card, sidebar, and button flat at rest; add elevation only for dropdowns/modals/toasts.
Do keep card/border colors neutral gray regardless of what's near them.
Do carry hierarchy through IBM Plex Sans weight and size, not a second typeface.
donts: Don't reintroduce the purple/indigo gradient hero banner, gradient pill buttons, or purple-tinted card shadows/borders.
Don't add decorative particle/sparkle effects to headings or banners.
Don't default to a warm cream/sand background to seem 'less AI'.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right as a stripe accent.
